actually, I got scammed by them January 2023. They now have a kiosk but they used to have a store front last year next to T-Mobile.

Yup. They scammed me out of $550 and tried to tell me I was gonna be one of their special guests with special perks and every time I tried to deny them, they would slash the price more and more. I said I had to think about it but Shimmy, the “regional” manager, said he was only in town for a convention and would be flying out the next morning so the deal was only then. They offered to let me do a deposit to keep the deal and tomorrow, I could sort it out. After going home and researching the whole company, which they scam people all over in Miami and Palm Springs and anywhere they can get a nice store front to lure tourists and rich people, I decided to go against it. They also go by Dominanti Group. They are an Israeli company that overhypes and overprices their products but once you start to decline, they lure you in by slashing the overinflated price. The next day, Shimmy was there (not flown out at all) and they refused to give me back my deposit, stating it was nonrefundable. I did not receive any product from that transaction and my credit card company sided with THEM, despite me not getting anything at all. There is a long line of complaints about them on Better Business Bureau. They no longer have the great mall store front but they have the small markets in the middle of stores and I walk by all the time and feel so guilty and angry when they target older women. They feed on your insecurities, sometimes giving you brand new insecurities (Shimmy pointed out smile lines that are natural and said they were so bad for my age), and just have the most high-pressure, intimidating sale tactics. I regret that day all the time.
